newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index lifted by Industrial shares.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index lifted by Industrial shares.

text.p: Marginal gains on Industrial shares boosted the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index on Wednesday in a moderate trading session, bourse officials said.
The index edged up 2.58 points to close at 3389.41. Turnover was posted at 18.950 million shillings on 351,909 shares compared to 36.868 million shillings on 1,296,387 shares on Tuesday.
Kenya Power & Lighting traded 30,000 shares at a reserve price of 149 from 146 on the one-hour hold special board.
Barclays Bank also traded on the one-hour special board at 115 from 112 while foreign investors traded Kenya Commercial Bank at between 94 and 94.50 from 94.

"A lot of people believe Kenya Power is the share of the future because they think it is undervalued," a senior broker told Reuters, adding this was the reason why the share had generated so much buying interest.
Some brokers said there was speculative buying of the financials on anticipated interim results, expected sometime in June/July.
Standard Chartered Bank shed a shilling to close at 46 while National Bank of Kenya closed at 16 from 15.90.
Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.50 while Uchumi Supermarket closed at 40 unchanged.
Sasini Tea & Coffee gained a shilling to close at 77 while Rea Vipingo closed at 8.80 from 8.85.

The Central Bank of Kenya floating rate treasury bond traded 22.6 million shillings at 103.7508 percent from 103.6441 percent while the East African Development Bank corporate bond traded 50 million shillings at 100.45 percent from 100.49 percent.
